matches.preview: The model narrowly favours Preston North End at 38%, with Blackburn Rovers on 33% and the draw at 29%, so this match is finely balanced. Preston’s closing six Championship results from last season included three defeats, although both victories came away from home. Blackburn also finished that campaign unevenly, drawing three of their final six matches and winning only once. The recent head-to-head record favours Blackburn, who won each of the last three meetings, including a 1-0 home success in February 2026. For total goals, the model leans towards under 2.5 at 56%, compared with 44% for over 2.5.
matches.preview_zh: 模型以38%微幅看好Preston North End，Blackburn Rovers為33%，和局為29%，顯示本場比賽局勢相當均衡。Preston上賽季最後六場Championship賽事吞下三敗，不過兩場勝利都是在客場取得。Blackburn在該賽季末段的表現同樣不穩定，最後六場比賽有三場戰平，且僅取得一勝。近期交手紀錄較有利於Blackburn，他們贏下最近三次交鋒，包括2026年2月在主場以1比0獲勝。總進球數方面，模型認為少於2．5球的可能性為56%，高於多於2．5球的44%。

Recent meetings have been evenly divided, with two wins for each side, while Stoke won both encounters played at home. The total-goals forecast leans towards under 2.5 goals at 58%.
matches.preview_zh: 模型預測 Stoke City 以 44% 的勝率略占優勢，平局機率為 29%，Charlton Athletic 的勝率則為 27%。Stoke 上賽季最後六場 Championship 賽事吞下五敗，其中三場未能進球。Charlton 的季末表現同樣不理想，最後六場比賽僅取得一勝，不過期間每場都有進球。雙方近期交手結果相當平均，各自取得兩勝，而在 Stoke 主場進行的兩次交鋒皆由 Stoke 獲勝。總進球數預測方面，少於 2.5 球的機率為 58%。

There are no recent Lincoln City matches or previous meetings on record, limiting the available comparison. The total-goals forecast leans towards over 2.5 goals at 55%, with under 2.5 goals rated at 45%.
matches.preview_zh: 模型較看好 Southampton，客場獲勝的機率為52%，Lincoln City 獲勝的機率為24%，平手則為25%。Southampton 在上季所列的六場比賽中保持不敗，取得四勝兩平。他們每場比賽也都至少攻進兩球，包括客場以3比1擊敗 Preston，以及主場以3比0戰勝 Blackburn。目前沒有 Lincoln City 近期比賽或雙方過往交手的紀錄，因此可供比較的資料有限。總進球數預測略偏向超過2.5球，機率為55%，低於2.5球的機率則為45%。
